tasks.name: Material Library
tasks.objective: Produce the Material Library for this project, meeting every acceptance criterion, then submit it for Studio Director review.
acceptance: Each material lists its maps, resolution, texel density and licence
Seamless tiling verified on a test plane
Every material parameter exposed to the shader is documented

reviews.note: All five material families have resolution, licence and shader parameters, and the 266 CC0 Quaternius models are recorded and pass the licence gate. The one criterion not met, a seamlessness test on an isolated plane, is stated as a gap instead of being claimed, which is the standard this studio asks for. The probe dependency for metal and water is documented for D12 to enforce. Approved.
